sentences.en: We ordered some special party hats for the kids to wear at the birthday celebration.
sentences.zh: 我们订了一些派对专用帽让孩子们在生日庆祝时戴上。

sentences.en: The guests were encouraged to come wearing their own special party hats tonight.
sentences.zh: 今晚被鼓励戴着自己买的派对专用帽来参加聚会。

sentences.en: I found a box of special party hats on sale, so I bought them for next month's event.
sentences.zh: 我发现有一盒派对专用帽打折，所以打算买下来为下个月的活动用。
